result.topic_en: Scattered formula-only calculations: rationalizing a sum of square roots, theta-quotient as a fourth root of products of characteristic factors, products of linear forms in u_1..u_4, and a parametrization of a quadratic via alpha, beta, gamma with relations between cubic coefficients.
